data.body: Epic snapshot: 48 of 117 remediation leaves were closed, with 55 open, 12 in progress, and 2 blocked. Parallel capacity was already occupied by three carried-over agents. Independently reviewed grisly-guardable-avocet at merged SHA aed541ddbde6d9860c8857dff3d97f054855728f. Posted one validated 18-row TSV receipt with digest 132b854c80a2e23b5882c866bb6f340290350e5090a984158bf8343b274fab44. Six scoped checks passed, including 183 focused tests with 1 skip, and Gerrit 2933 is merged with both votes and zero unresolved comments. The close precheck required a plan refresh after the operator-approved CI substitution changed acceptance text. That refresh was not admitted because both host gate slots were occupied. No retry was made and the leaf remains in progress.
